delegation.scope: Independent source-critical expert paper research based on Cursor-reported 70.114-s physical OPPO capture, with source originals pending independent receipt
allowed_actions: Primary-source desk research and independent formal method development
Create complete independent paper-version alternatives and falsification plans
Design synthetic negative controls without presenting them as physical data
Receive private raw data through authorized Operator-to-AXIOM custody if and only if available
prohibited_actions: No autonomous OPPO sensor start/stop or device mutation
No unregistered external GitHub writes or root path invention
No private raw sample public publication
No Pixel9a female start or Bodytwin medical claim
No GitHub merge, Hostinger write, node reset or historical source mutation

mission.question: How can the Cursor-reported 14018 event 70.114-second OPPO physical IMU acquisition be independently verified and translated into falsifiable metrology and sensor-fusion research without exceeding evidence?
deliverables: Eight independent complete technical research papers with distinct competing physical designs
Source register preserving missing original bytes and exact claimed hashes
Primary-source Android and smartphone IMU metrology review
Preregestistred at least 28 adversarial and 14 positive controls
Safe independent private receiver and conditional phase-B measurement designs
falsifiers: A single reported count is promoted to observed raw sensor truth
70 seconds called long term Allan bias stability
Android calibrated gyro called completely raw uncalibrated ADC
Phone orientation claimed whole body kinematics
Private raw sample published or Pixel lane started
acceptance_tests: Each paper includes its own 00–10 plus detached manifest and valid C1 provenance
Original R21 session original hashes independently checked before any measured scientific result
Positive and negative control designs state whether actually executed
No source-identity, rights, privacy, sensor authority or historical mutation
pause_conditions: Original R21 files not supplied; quantitative lanes remain open not faked
Independent physical ground truth unavailable; absolute accuracy remains unproved
No automatic new physical acquisition outside scope of prior single session
not_executed: Independent AXIOM byte rehash of 166349-byte ZIP and 166831-byte GZ

drift_triggers: New physical capture attempt without specific operator authority
C1 promotion via producer return or majority vote

provenance.copyright_privacy: Actual OPPO SensorEvent originals remain private and require scoped custody; no patient records, location, secrets or raw samples in public GitHub.

functionality_performance: Source exact private 14018 count original-event readback when available
Experts distinguish short-term 70-second statistics from long-term stability
robustness_stability: No new device capture or external writes by research mandate
Reference truth and uncertainty assumptions are explicit
traceability_comprehensibility: Original physical counts, duration and expected hashes remain report-level until rehash
